prompts.name: RIFF — STREAMLINER
prompts.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept / precise vehicle redesign.
Input image 1 is the previous concept sheet, an edit target. PRESERVE ONLY the exact monster's identity, color, eye count, face, horns/ears/stalks, material finish, and overall polished cartoon rendering. Preserve the ivory studio background and four-view sheet layout.
User correction: the previous vehicles were all basically the same car recolored. Completely REPLACE THE ENTIRE VEHICLE GEOMETRY in EVERY panel with the new architecture below. This must be obvious in a black silhouette: change chassis proportions, wheel diameter/spacing, nose, cockpit position, mechanical construction and rear profile. Do not merely recolor or decorate the old rounded roadster. The old kart in the reference is specifically rejected.
The monster stays seated in the NEW vehicle in all views, hands on reachable controls and feet inside footwell; all anatomy and vehicle fully in frame. Premium polished stylized 3D arcade racer, rounded appealing manufactured surfaces, saturated satin paint, rubber and metal, no realism/grunge, no logos.
Landscape 1536x1024 or higher, 2x2 spacious layout: top-left front three-quarter hero, top-right straight front, bottom-left side profile, bottom-right straight rear. SAME NEW geometry in all four panels with consistent wheel counts and proportions; don't retain old bodywork in any view. Small labels FRONT THREE QUARTER, FRONT, SIDE, REAR. One short header below. Clear readable construction suitable for Blender modeling. All vehicles remain compact single-seat kart-scale, exactly four ground-contact wheels. Keep the character the primary subject and never hide its distinctive head.

Header: RIFF — STREAMLINER
NEW VEHICLE DESIGN: A low, long vintage open-wheel torpedo speedster. Narrow elongated teardrop nose projects far ahead of the driver and between separately mounted front wheels, exposed slim front wishbones, no front fenders, absolutely no oval grille and no pair of round headlights. Tiny horizontal nose vent, low wraparound cockpit rim, slim tapering boat-tail rear with single center exhaust. Front wheels visibly smaller and narrower than broad rear slicks. Cream main fuselage with turquoise lower strip and thin coral longitudinal stripe. Driver sits low near rear axle. Silhouette: long-low pointed torpedo, sparse open running gear. Cartoon handmade racing machine.
